CANONICAL_NAME.value: LevelDB 1.23 -- log-structured merge key-value store (Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat; Google)

value.lineage: LSM-tree storage (O'Neil et al. 1996) as Google built it for Chrome/IndexedDB in 2011: a write-ahead log, an in-memory memtable, sorted on-disk tables, and background compaction; RECOVERY replays the log. Ancestor of RocksDB (Facebook fork, 2012).

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: durable ordered key-value storage under heavy write load

value.built_to: absorb writes fast by appending to a log and merging later, and recover the unflushed tail of the log after a crash
value.pressure: write bursts, bounded memory (memtable), background compaction competing with foreground I/O, crash mid-write
value.success_means: every acknowledged write is readable after reopen; compaction keeps read cost bounded

value.pressure: write bursts, bounded memory, crash mid-write, foreground/background contention
value.failure_condition: lost acknowledged writes after a crash, or unbounded read amplification

ANCESTRY.value: LSM-tree storage (O'Neil et al. 1996) as Google built it for Chrome/IndexedDB in 2011: a write-ahead log, an in-memory memtable, sorted on-disk tables, and background compaction; RECOVERY replays the log. Ancestor of RocksDB (Facebook fork, 2012).

ancestry_edges.note: human history: the fork became the mainstream LSM engine; LevelDB continues
